```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
#formula for calculation here
#https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40168-023-01738-0#Sec12
# δ13C (‰) = ( rC(sample) / rC(unlabeled) - 1 ) * 1000
# δ15N (‰) = ( rN(sample) / rN(unlabeled) - 1 ) * 1000
#
# where rC(sample) and rC(unlabeled) are the count ratios of 13C12C−/12C2−
# in the sample and in an unlabeled control, respectively.
# rN(sample) and rN(unlabeled) are the count ratios of 15N12C−/14N12C−
# in the sample and in an unlabeled control, respectively.

# ----------------------------
# Load + compute delta values
# ----------------------------
dat <- read.csv("Nutrient_data2026.csv")

Rbase_N <- c(Host = 0.00374, Symbiont = 0.00371)
Rbase_C <- c(Host = 0.01093, Symbiont = 0.01083)


my_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#4292c6",
  "Heat"    = "coral1",
  "Hnit"    = "#D65278"
)
str(dat)
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control","Heat","Hnit")),
    Fraction  = factor(Fraction,  levels = c("Host","Symbiont")),
    Delta15N  = (`X15N.14N.ratio` / Rbase_N[Fraction] - 1) * 1000,
    Delta13C  = (`X13C.12C.ratio` / Rbase_C[Fraction] - 1) * 1000
  )
```



```{r}
# split into two matrices host and sym
host_df <- dat %>% filter(Fraction == "Host")
sym_df  <- dat %>% filter(Fraction == "Symbiont")

# (optional sanity check)
table(host_df$Treatment)
table(sym_df$Treatment)
```


```{r}
#HOST long + summary
host_long <- host_df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Delta13C, Delta15N), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Delta13C","Delta15N")))

host_sum <- host_long %>%
  group_by(Treatment, metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
host_sum
```


```{r}
# HOST stats delta13C
m_host_C <- lm(Delta13C ~ Treatment, data = host_df)
cat("\n================ HOST: Δ13C ================\n")
print(anova(m_host_C))
```


```{r}
print(pairs(emmeans(m_host_C, ~ Treatment), adjust = "tukey"))
```


```{r}
host_letters_C <- cld(
  emmeans(m_host_C, ~ Treatment),
  Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(Treatment, metric = "Delta13C", letter = gsub(" ", "", .group))
host_letters_C
```


```{r}
# ---- HOST stats delta15N
m_host_N <- lm(Delta15N ~ Treatment, data = host_df)
print(anova(m_host_N))
```


```{r}
print(pairs(emmeans(m_host_N, ~ Treatment), adjust = "tukey"))
```


```{r}
host_letters_N <- cld(
  emmeans(m_host_N, ~ Treatment),
  Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(Treatment, metric = "Delta15N", letter = gsub(" ", "", .group))
host_letters_N
```


```{r}
# ---- HOST letters + y positions
host_letters <- bind_rows(host_letters_C, host_letters_N) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Delta13C","Delta15N")))

host_ypos <- host_long %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    span  = diff(range(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(y_lab = y_max + 0.08 * span)

host_letters <- host_letters %>% left_join(host_ypos, by = "metric")
host_letters
```


```{r}
# ---- HOST plot
p_host <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = host_sum,
    aes(Treatment, mean, fill = Treatment),
    width = 0.7, alpha = 0.7,
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = host_sum,
    aes(Treatment, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = host_long,
    aes(Treatment, value, fill = Treatment),
    width = 0.12, height = 0,
    size = 2.6, alpha = 0.9,
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = host_letters,
    aes(Treatment, y_lab, label = letter),
    fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(metric = c(
      Delta13C = "Host: Δ13C (‰) vs baseline",
      Delta15N = "Host: Δ15N (‰) vs baseline"
    ))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Per mil (‰)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_host
ggsave("Host_DeltaC_DeltaN_letters.pdf", plot = p_host, width = 5, height = 3, units = "in")
```
